page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance configured under the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs paired with 60.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 7.5 GB per core. The hardware profile is distinguished by the integration of two NVIDIA P100 graphics processing units, delivering a combined 32 GB of video RAM to support parallel computing tasks.

For local data storage, the instance includes a bundled 944 GB SSD, offering high-speed local read and write capabilities directly attached to the host. Networking performance is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps, facilitating steady data transfer rates for distributed workloads and external communications.

Given the dual NVIDIA P100 GPU configuration and dedicated CPU resources, this instance is designed for GPU-accelerated workloads such as deep learning training, scientific simulations, and high-performance computing. The presence of local SSD storage also makes it suitable for database operations and data processing tasks that require fast temporary storage. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the bundling of dedicated compute, dual GPUs, and local SSD storage provides a consolidated hardware profile for resource-intensive applications.
